verdict.rationale: ByteAsk is mainly a terminal TUI agent. Its own docs say VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains connectors are live, and the llms.txt index lists editor connectors. Nothing describes what these connectors do, so there is no evidence of a chat panel or contextual help inside the IDE. Missing for 10: documentation of in-IDE chat UI, editor context sharing (open file/selection), connector setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can chat with the coding assistant directly inside my IDE for contextual help

citations.quote: VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains (CLion, IDEA, PyCharm) connectors are live.
with install channels, editor connectors, pricing tiers, and data-handling policy in the same agent-readable file
